title: Move Zeroes
summary: Move every zero to the end of the array in place while keeping the other values in their original order.

tests.explain: The non-zero values 1, 3, 12 keep their order; the two zeroes go to the end. The test checks nums after your function returns.

hints: Don't return anything: change nums itself. The tests look at nums after your function runs.
Keep a write pointer for the next slot that should hold a non-zero value, and scan with a read pointer.
When read finds a non-zero, swap it into the write slot and advance write. Zeroes drift to the back on their own.
